mapper.sql: w.id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.warehouse_type, w.store_id, w.user_id, w.contact_name, w.contact_phone, w.area_code, w.area_zh, w.address, w.longitude, w.latitude, w.capacity, w.capacity_warn, w.capacity_used, w.warn_enable, w.status, w.create_by, w.update_by, w.create_time, w.update_time
FROM shop_erp_warehouse w LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = w.store_id AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = w.user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , st.store_name AS storeName, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_erp_warehouse w SET w.capacity_used = (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.stock), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.is_deleted = 0) WHERE w.id = #{warehouseId} AND w.is_deleted = 0
